t: An open-source tool that watches, copies and builds USB devices.
steps: Buy a Cynthion from an authorized reseller such as Adafruit or Crowd Supply.
Gather a USB-C cable and a USB-A cable. They do not come in the box.
Install Python 3.9 or newer on your computer.
Run the command pip install cynthion in a terminal.
Run cynthion setup on Linux, or install libusb on a Mac.
Plug your computer into the port labeled CONTROL and run cynthion info.
Run cynthion update to load the latest firmware.
Install Packetry and capture the traffic from a USB keyboard as your first test.
